title.en: Anthropic launches Claude Duet AI assistant

current_state.zh: Anthropic 推出研究预览版 Claude Duet，这是一款基于 Claude Opus 5.5 构建的主动式智能体助手，运行在自带浏览器的云虚拟机中，可提供每日简报、通过 6000 多个连接器执行多步骤业务任务，敏感操作需用户明确批准，同时禁止证券交易和账户转账等操作。
current_state.en: Anthropic launched Claude Duet in research preview, a proactive agentic assistant built on Claude Opus 5.5 that runs in a cloud VM with its own browser, delivers daily briefings, executes multi-step business tasks across 6,000+ connectors, and requires explicit user approval for sensitive actions while prohibiting others such as securities trading and account transfers.

updates.title_zh: Anthropic推出新AI智能体Claude Duet，正面迎战Muse
updates.what_changed_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Duet，这是一款由 Opus 5.5 驱动的新 AI 个人助手产品，引发 Hacker News 对其能力、用例和推理成本优势的讨论。
updates.what_changed_en: Anthropic introduced Claude Duet, a new AI personal-assistant product powered by Opus 5.5, prompting Hacker News discussion of its capabilities, use cases, and inference-cost advantages.

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Anthropic introduced Claude Duet, a new AI personal-assistant product powered by Opus 5.5, prompting Hacker News discussion of its capabilities, use cases, and inference-cost advantages.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Anthropic introduced Claude Duet, a new AI personal-assistant product powered by Opus 5.5, prompting Hacker News discussion of its capabilities, use cases, and inference-cost advantages.
updates.background_zh: Claude Duet进入的是一个已相当拥挤的智能体市场：Meta推出Muse，将其定位为运行在专用“Muse Secure VM”上的个人AI智能体；OpenAI则在2026年9月29日的DevDay 2026主题演讲上发布了“始终在线”的Dots智能体。此前Anthropic的Claude产品主要通过对话界面使用，而非主动式的独立智能体应用。
updates.background_en: Claude Duet enters a crowded agent market: Meta introduced Muse as a personal AI agent running on a dedicated "Muse Secure VM," and OpenAI launched Dots as always-on agents at its DevDay 2026 keynote on September 29, 2026. Anthropic's previous Claude offerings were primarily accessed through chat interfaces rather than a proactive, standalone agent app.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此次发布强化了三大实验室围绕“始终在线”AI智能体的竞争叙事，这一主题通常影响的是与AI相关的加密板块情绪，而非某一代币的基本面。传导路径主要是叙事与资金关注度流向智能体概念代币及AI算力、推理相关资产，而非直接的协议层面敞口。
updates.market_impact_en: The release feeds the competitive narrative around always-on AI agents from the three largest labs, a theme that typically moves sentiment in AI-adjacent crypto segments rather than any single token's fundamentals. Any transmission would run through narrative and attention flows toward agent-branded tokens and AI compute/inference-related assets, not through direct protocol exposure.
